src: 5x5 work blocks s outside the teal legend panel
dst: colored legend shape entries d inside the teal panel
match_cond: pattern block marker mask matches d.shape up to rotation/reflection; solid block color equals d.color
transform: rewrite s in place: matched pattern blocks become solid d.color; matched solid blocks become the common two-color 5x5 pattern with d.shape centered as marker cells
symbol_instructions: teal panel maps each colored shape to its color; common pattern uses the shared border/base color and marker color from two-color blocks
